scope: mask-only independent review; no generated H&E was available or used

decisions.reason: All three candidates pass the frozen hard gates; candidate 01 is selected because it has the strongest frozen local-density score and the least inflated count and Ripley ratios while retaining coherent immune-region geometry.
decisions.tissue_geometry: The 49,283-pixel joint change forms connected authorized stroma-to-immune regions; its 46,594-pixel tissue component preserves adjacent tumor and non-target compartments.
decisions.nucleus_layout: Thirty-six class-2 nuclei are complete, non-overlapping and contained. Source-relative area-p95, count, NND and Ripley ratios are 0.962, 1.175, 0.934 and 1.078, less shifted overall than the other passing alternatives.
decisions.coupling: Added immune nuclei remain inside authorized changed tissue; quota, seam, compatibility, distribution and density checks pass with score 0.901.
decisions.preserved_conditions: Protected nuclei, prohibited regions and support-exterior instances remain unchanged without partial-instance, overlap or containment violations.
decisions.limitations: The target population is moderately more numerous and clustered than source, although within the frozen envelope. Mask-only evidence does not establish generated-H&E quality or clinical validity.
decisions.verdict: Approve candidate 01 as the single mask-condition handoff.
